purpose: Teach: あきらめる/リーズナブル/数時間/いえよ/一遍/しきりに/たいして/そのうえ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、あきらめるなよ。次のテスト頑張れ
lines.en: Riku, don't give up. You can do better on the next test.
lines.style: Direct, almost fierce. Lean in slightly. Quick tempo. The firmness of someone who believes in him more than he believes in himself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お小遣いでリーズナブルなお店行こうぜ、桜
lines.en: Hey, let's hit up somewhere reasonable with our pocket money, Sakura.
lines.style: Casual pivot, like he's dodging. Light, almost cheerful. Normal conversational pace. The deflection of someone changing the subject before it gets too close.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、塾で数時間ねばってたな
lines.en: Yeah, you were stuck in cram school for hours the other day.
lines.style: Dry observation. Slight smirk in the delivery. Not accusing—just stating the obvious back at him. A beat before finishing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、好きならちゃんと「好き」っていえよ、桜
lines.en: If you actually like something, just say it. Say 'I like it,' Sakura.
lines.style: Softer than his words suggest. Eye contact steady. The courage it takes to be direct about something real. No performance, just honesty.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、一遍真剣に勉強してみろよ
lines.en: Riku, just try studying seriously for once. Actually try.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact challenge. Not harsh—practical. She's not lecturing; she's calling out the gap between his potential and his effort.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、しきりにスマホ見てんな、桜
lines.en: You're always looking at your phone, Sakura.
lines.style: Light accusation. Wry, almost teasing. Normal pace. The easy ribbing of someone pointing out what they both already know.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、たいして勉強してないだろ
lines.en: You're barely studying anyway, are you?
lines.style: Dry challenge. Not mean-spirited. She's mirroring his deflections back at him with a slight edge. A knowing pause at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト満点。そのうえ、運動もできるよな、桜
lines.en: Perfect test scores and you're good at sports too, huh, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet admiration wrapped in casualness. Slow delivery on the last phrase. Not quite a compliment—more like he's marveling at her despite himself.
